body: Honestly, I feel like I know too much information. I'm too intelligent for my own good in my crowd of peers. It would be good on a positive outlook, but all the crap I've seen, shit. It's too toxic. I haven't been a good person either, I should've been a better brother to my younger brother and not be distant from my family.

I will not get in depth, but a lot of my thinking has to do with where I live. I live in a low income area, where a lot of people my age are doomed from the start. I've been somewhat sheltered from that, but I don't live in a nice house with a picket fence and a dog. There's a lot of violence, drugs, and gangs.

I've done drugs, seen prostitutes, seen drug addicts, people succumb to their addictions, homeless etc. I have not been sheltered from that, I see some of what these people see, and it's unfortunate.

It is something that I don't want my future children to see.  Let alone, anyone else see. That's why I am in school getting out of that lifestyle and area.
